note: Real. Scored by analysis/statistics/checks.py against the written rules in research/predictions.md.

checks.name: Aqua's look time over each Brazilian biome rises every year 2021-2025; VIIRS stays flat
checks.detail: Reading (a) 2022-2025 each >= prior year: 6/6 biomes. Reading (b) also 2021 >= 2020: 3/6 (amazon 2021 vs 2020: -0.7 min; cerrado 2021 vs 2020: -0.9 min; pantanal 2021 vs 2020: -0.6 min). S-NPP within 10 min of 2012-2020 every year: 6/6. Readings disagree: the team must pick one in research/predictions.md before this is scored.

checks.name: Punjab Aqua look time follows Jethva 2026 (1:44 PM in 2021 to 3:12 PM in 2025)
checks.detail: Aqua later every year 2021-2025: yes; total rise 76 min (rule 60-120). Our absolute times run 27-39 min earlier than Jethva's; time convention not yet checked.

checks.name: Our FIRMS Aqua data reproduces INPE's reference counts
checks.detail: Biome-months 2012-2020 within 10% of INPE: 96.6% with all daytime Aqua detections, 81.6% with the plan's filters (type 0, confidence >= 30). Rule: >= 90%. Note: P3 was computed before the predictions were committed (see the honest timeline).

checks.name: Day-to-day sampling noise explains the pre-drift wobble
checks.detail: Placebo years (2012-2020, each held out) whose 95% block-bootstrap interval contains 1: amazon 7/9, cerrado 9/9, caatinga 7/9, mata_atlantica 7/9, pantanal 8/9, pampa 8/9. Rule: >= 7/9. Detection rule used: L outside the placebo range.

checks.name: Fire-size mix doesn't explain the audit
checks.detail: L_strat (days split into S-NPP mean-FRP terciles, reweighted to the 2012-2020 mix) inside L's 95% interval in 29/29 biome-years 2021-2025. Largest move: 0.098. Day-level classes (the daily file has no per-detection FRP).

checks.name: VIIRS is a stable clock
checks.detail: L with NOAA-20 as reference inside L with S-NPP's 95% interval in 30/30 biome-years 2021-2025 (both baselines 2018-2020, the years both satellites flew). Largest gap: 0.183.

checks.name: Closure: the timing slope predicts the observed L
checks.detail: L_pred inside the 90% interval of L in 17/23 strict biome-years (74%; rule >= 75%). beta = log(Aqua/Terra) per hour of look-time gap, 2012-2020 (same MODIS sensor, same days). Misses: amazon 2023 (pred 1.11, obs 1.02), amazon 2024 (pred 1.28, obs 1.11), caatinga 2024 (pred 1.23, obs 1.48), mata_atlantica 2023 (pred 1.10, obs 0.99), mata_atlantica 2024 (pred 1.26, obs 1.16), pantanal 2024 (pred 1.10, obs 0.93).

checks.name: VIIRS detects small real fires better than MODIS
checks.detail: a50 (fire size detected half the time), 2012-2020: S-NPP 319 acres [271.0, 375.1], Aqua 946 acres [777.2, 1168.0]. Not pre-registered (computed before the commit).

checks.name: Opposite drifts move the Terra and Aqua probes in opposite directions
checks.detail: Pass in 3/6 biomes with beta > 0: amazon A up, T down; cerrado A not monotone, T down; caatinga A up, T down; mata_atlantica A up, T not monotone; pantanal A not monotone, T not monotone; pampa A up, T down. Deviation: the written gate uses VIIRS same-day pairs, but S-NPP and NOAA-20 look at the same local time (13:31 vs 13:31 over the Amazon in 2024), so that slope cannot be measured. Gate used: the MODIS Terra/Aqua slope beta.

checks.name: The two-clock difference agrees with the audit
checks.detail: Clock share of log A_y = clock_diff x dA/(dA - dT) inside the 95% interval of log L_y in 14/23 biome-years 2022-2025 (61%; rule >= 75%). Misses: amazon 2025, cerrado 2025, caatinga 2023, caatinga 2024, mata_atlantica 2023, mata_atlantica 2025, pantanal 2023, pantanal 2024, pantanal 2025.
